Sam: Found this in a config folder, may be cursed. :skull:
Sam: ```
service:
  name: payments
  version: 1.0.0.0-beta
  deploy: true
```
Julia: that's not semver, that's avant-garde versioning. :scream:
Omar: Compiler joke: 'Optimized away my coffee, now my code runs cold.' :coffee:
CI-bot: Build #4823 succeeded on branch feature/semver-exorcism :white_check_mark:
Lily: Quick poll: if you had to pick a new versioning scheme, would you choose:
Lily: 1) Date-based 2) Commit-hash 3) Random emoji
Ben: Random emoji would make release notes funnier and terrifying. :eyes:
Julia: Also YAML: 'indentation is a personality test' :joy:
Sam: I fixed the version to 1.0.0 and pushed a PR. https://github.com/redwood-inference/example-configs/pull/42
Omar: approve :thumbsup:
Lily: :tada: Bonus: added a linter rule to reject more-than-3-segment versions (sorry, nostalgia).
Ben: Please don't outlaw my '1.0' nostalgia.
Sam: OK fine, allowed nostalgia but semver police will ticket you. :police_car:
CI-bot: PR merged by Sam into main.
Julia: archival note: if you see '1.0.0.0-beta' again, consider an exorcism. :ghost:
